snapshot_failed: Could not read local gateway data. Refresh or open the full controls for details.
agent_saved: Saved. Reload or restart that agent to use its new configuration.
action_failed: The change could not be saved. Existing user edits were not forced.
no_snapshot: No gateway snapshot yet. Use Refresh to try again.
agent_intro: Select an installed agent to change its saved model or route group.
quota_local: Saved readings. Update contacts the selected account’s provider; the top refresh only rereads local data.
quota_empty_detail: Select Update on a supported account to fetch a reading. Accounts are never refreshed in the background.
usage_partial: Partial history: some records or older data were outside the bounded local scan.
usage_unavailable: Local usage history is unavailable. These values are not a complete total.
routing_intro: Apply a model or group to a specific agent. Existing group rules stay in the gateway.
groups_empty: No route groups. Individual models are available in the selector below.
confirm_revert: Restore this agent’s saved configuration backup?
open_desktop: Open desktop GUI or full controls
choose_agent_above: Choose an agent above to change its route.
cost_estimate_note: Estimate from saved model prices, not a provider bill.
cost_recorded_note: Recorded cost. Unpriced requests are excluded.
cost_unknown_note: No reliable price is available for these requests.
quota_update_hint: Fetch this account’s quota from its provider
quota_helper_update: Quota updates need the current compatibility helper. Update zcalld-compat; saved readings remain available.
quota_unavailable_help: This account cannot report quota here. Open Accounts to check its setup.
quota_error_unsupported: This provider does not expose quota. Check its own account page.
quota_error_capability_unknown: Quota support is not known. Update the provider plugin and reread local data.
quota_error_plugin_unavailable: The provider plugin is unavailable. Install or repair it in Plugins.
quota_error_plugin_disabled: Enable this provider plugin in Plugins before updating quota.
quota_error_account_unavailable: This account is unavailable. Open Accounts to check its setup.
quota_error_account_disabled: Enable this account in Accounts before updating quota.
quota_error_external_owner: Another application manages this sign-in. Update its login before retrying here.
quota_error_invalid_account: The selected account changed. Reread local data and choose it again.
quota_error_timeout: The provider timed out. The saved reading is unchanged; try Update again later.
quota_error_provider_error: The provider could not report quota. The saved reading is unchanged; try again later.
quota_error_account_or_plugin_changed: The account or plugin changed during the update. Reread local data before retrying.
quota_error_cache_limit: The quota cache is full. Review saved accounts before updating again.
